description: A retrospective Arab Times report says Bangladeshi workers reached out to their embassy in November over unpaid wages, but gives no date, place, attendance or physical gathering. It is excluded from event coding on current evidence.
required_followup: Search contemporaneous November 2024 Arabic/local news, embassy notices or worker-group records for an in-person gathering and participant count; do not infer one from an embassy complaint.

description: Seven open-web queries, including two half-month checks and targeted labor/migrant/education searches, did not identify a contemporaneous November public protest; old 2019/2011 records and unrelated country hits were prominent. No comprehensive local archive or LexisNexis search was possible.
required_followup: If accessible, search local Arabic newspaper/union archives by week and worker sector for 1–30 November, distinguishing public action from a private labor complaint.

description: The October teacher-transfer gathering was searched for November follow-up, with only the same story found. The December school-cleaner strike resolution does not establish whether that separate strike began in November.
required_followup: Seek a dated onset report for the school-cleaner strike and separate follow-up for the teacher-transfer issue; do not merge these unrelated issues.
